name: Bears a Halo of Fire
description: You control flames and heat, manipulating them to your advantage.
connectionOptions: One PC is deathly afraid of fire because of you.
You once saved one PC from a fire.
You and one PC have a mutual friend who was killed in a fire.

abilities.name: Shroud of Flame
abilities.description: At will, you can surround yourself with flames that last for up to 10 minutes. The flames don't burn you, but they inflict 1 point of damage to anyone who touches you.

abilities.name: Hurl Flame
abilities.description: You can throw a small bolt of fire a short distance, inflicting 2 points of damage.

abilities.name: Fiery Hand of Doom
abilities.description: Your touch inflicts damage as a medium weapon, and you can choose to inflict fire damage instead of normal damage.

abilities.name: Flameblade
abilities.description: You can cause a weapon you wield to burst into flames for 1 minute, giving it +2 to damage.

abilities.name: Fire Tendrils
abilities.description: You can attack up to three foes within short range with tendrils of flame, inflicting 3 points of damage on each target.

abilities.name: Flamestrike
abilities.description: You can call down a pillar of flame on a target within long range, inflicting 6 points of damage.

abilities.name: Living Flame
abilities.description: You can transform your body into living flame for up to 1 minute. While in this form, you can fly, pass through small openings, and are immune to fire damage.
